description: Add an image to a persona image library from a local file path (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB). Optional tag and description drive the deterministic per-video image selection. The server rejects full libraries (10 max).

description.description: Description of the photo for tag/keyword matching (e.g. smiling at the beach at sunset)

isPrimary.description: Set true to mark this image as the primary library image (false is rejected — a new image is not primary unless marked)

path.description: Local file path to the image (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB)

personaId.description: The ID of the persona to add the image to

tag.description: Short tag for deterministic per-video matching (e.g. casual, formal, gym)

name: add_persona_image
